name: DropPublisherName
title: The hand-typed publisher name goes away
summary: Second step of `AddPublishers`: `book.publisher_name` is dropped, and the author's `name` becomes `full_name`.

notes.why: Every running version of the application now writes `book.publisher_id`; the old column is dead weight.
notes.compatibility: Only deploy once the versions that wrote `publisher_name` are all stopped. The application must read `author.full_name` from this release on.
notes.deployment:
1. Check that no running instance still writes `book.publisher_name`.
2. Apply the migration and deploy the application in the same release.

data.description: Down puts the publisher's name back in `book.publisher_name` for the books that have one.
data.down: UPDATE book b SET publisher_name = p.name FROM publisher p WHERE p.id = b.publisher_id;
